description: This file defines the ImageOverlay class for the Leaflet mapping library, enabling loading and displaying a single image over specified map bounds with customizable options.

classes.name: ImageOverlay
classes.description: A class extending Layer to load and display a single image overlay on a map with various customizable options.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the ImageOverlay with URL, bounds, and options.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles adding the overlay to the map, initializing the image element.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Handles removing the overlay from the map.

methods.name: setOpacity
methods.description: Sets the opacity of the image overlay.

methods.name: bringToFront
methods.description: Brings the overlay to the top layer.

methods.name: bringToBack
methods.description: Brings the overlay to the bottom layer.

methods.name: setBounds
methods.description: Updates the geographical bounds of the overlay.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns event handlers for map interactions.

methods.name: setZIndex
methods.description: Sets the z-index of the overlay.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the current bounds of the overlay.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Returns the HTMLImageElement used for the overlay.

methods.name: _initImage
methods.description: Initializes the image element, setting attributes and event handlers.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the image position and size based on map bounds.

methods.name: _updateZIndex
methods.description: Updates the z-index style of the image.

methods.name: _overlayOnError
methods.description: Handles image load errors, optionally replacing the URL.
